name: Sakurakawa Ayana
source:
She dated Souma when they were still students. When they graduated, Souma went overseas, and eventually, Ayana wanted to break up, which ended their relationship.

Originally, she was supposed to be the successor of Oukadou, but since she wasn't as interested in making Japanese confectioneries as Tomomi, she handed over the right to her younger sister, who is very enthusiastic in making sweets. 

When they were students, she was worried about Souma's teeth because of his fondness for anything sweet, and thus she decided to pursue a career related to dentistry. 

She's gentle, kind, and obliging. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/yobai4/chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
